Root cause: the gate command was never broken. 'git verify command-gate subject' is the synthetic label NEEDLE reports for GateSubject::verify_current (NEEDLE src/validation/mod.rs:361-386): after a hermetic clean-extraction verification of the captured revision it requires the shared workspace HEAD to still equal the capture. This workspace's own maintenance automation commits .beads/checkpoint residue within ~10s of agent exit (needle-checkpoint-unwedge timer fires every 10s; bead-rs auto-stages the checkpoint on every store write), while the default_rust gate (builtin cargo check --all-targets --quiet, CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2, cold target dir) runs ~20min — so every outcome gate lost the race: 15 consecutive errors, workspace degraded. Evidence: the captured..final range afee532..fd7ccd2 and the pre-push origin/main..HEAD range touch .beads/ only, zero source changes; every 'HEAD changed' error is this race, not a source break. Fix delivered within workspace scope: zero uncommitted residue left at exit — checkpoint residue committed (f0ff907) and pushed before exit, so the outcome gate's window is churn-free (degraded workspaces take no concurrent dispatches, and the unwedge finds nothing staged to commit; HEAD stays pinned). Durable NEEDLE-side fix belongs to a NEEDLE-repo bead (outside this dispatch's write scope): in clean mode the HEAD-equality check should accept a fast-forwarded HEAD (captured revision still an ancestor of HEAD), since the verification judges the immutable captured tree, not the moving checkout.

Checklist: (1) git status --short before staging listed only .beads/checkpoint residue staged by my own dispatch's publications; committed path-limited (-- .beads), nothing of other workers swept in. (2) Repository definition of done run in a git-archive extraction of committed HEAD 2665e0e (/var/tmp/beadrs-dod-LsrD): scripts/definition-of-done.sh --fast → 'PASS: fmt + test', exit 0; extraction removed after success. (3) Bead acceptance criteria are gate-runtime conditions (gate runs, no stderr, exit 0) that NEEDLE re-checks with its own gate on this close; no repo test commands are named in the bead. (4) Pushed 6402894..f0ff907 to origin main; git rev-list origin/main..HEAD is empty.

issue.description:
## Gate Execution Error

The gate command `git verify command-gate subject` failed to execute in workspace `/home/coding/bead-rs`.

### Error Details
- **Gate**: default_rust
- **Command**: `git verify command-gate subject`
- **Reason**: workspace HEAD changed from captured revision afee532ddaf47531d926f1a6059f09c9ba0d2d6b to fd7ccd26b907a18cdd61bd54f37e11c4668901a8 while verification ran
- **Consecutive errors**: 11

### Impact
This workspace is now **degraded**. Pluck and Explore strands will skip it for ordinary dispatch.
The workspace remains claimable for manual intervention or fixing this specific gate.

### Resolution
Fix the gate command (e.g., install missing dependency, correct path, resolve permissions) 
and the workspace will be automatically restored on the next successful gate run.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Gate command runs successfully
- [ ] No stderr errors (ENOENT, EACCES, timeout)
- [ ] Exit code is 0

### Verification
The gate command will be re-run on the next dispatch attempt. A successful run will:
- Clear the degraded state
- Close this bead automatically
- Restore normal workspace operation
issue.notes: Diagnosis (2026-09-25): not a broken gate command. Gate default_rust runs the builtin 'cargo check --all-targets --quiet' in a hermetic archive extraction of the captured revision, then GateSubject::verify_current (NEEDLE src/validation/mod.rs:361) requires the shared workspace HEAD to still equal the capture. This workspace's own maintenance automation commits .beads/checkpoint/* residue within ~10s of agent exit (needle-checkpoint-unwedge.timer fires every 10s; bead-rs auto-stages checkpoint on every store write). The gate inherits CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 and a cold target dir, so its window is ~20 min — matching the 20-22 min gaps between captured and final revisions in the errors. Proven: afee532..fd7ccd2 and origin/main..HEAD touch .beads/ only; zero source changes. Every 'HEAD changed' error is this race, not a source break. Fix delivered within workspace scope: leave zero uncommitted residue at exit (checkpoint residue committed + pushed before and after close) so the outcome gate runs on a quiet tree; unwedge then finds nothing to commit and HEAD stays pinned for the whole window. Durable NEEDLE-side fix (out of this dispatch's scope, for a NEEDLE-repo bead): in clean mode the HEAD-equality check should accept a fast-forward (captured revision still an ancestor of HEAD) since the verification is of the immutable captured tree, not the moving checkout.
